speakers.name: Navtej Sarna
speakers.title: Former Indian Ambassador to the United States · Author
speakers.bio: Navtej Sarna is a distinguished diplomat, acclaimed author, and former Indian Ambassador to the United States (2016–2018). A member of the Indian Foreign Service from 1980, he also served as India’s High Commissioner to the UK, Ambassador to Israel, and Secretary in the Ministry of External Affairs. He was India’s longest-serving official spokesperson for the Ministry of External Affairs. An award-winning writer, his novel Crimson Spring received the Sahitya Akademi Award (2025) and the KLF Best Fiction Award (2022). Sarna has authored several acclaimed novels, non-fiction works, translations, and continues to write extensively on foreign policy, history, and literature.

speakers.name: Dr. Shashi Tharoor
speakers.title: Member of Parliament, Thiruvananthapuram · Author · Former UN Under-Secretary-General
speakers.bio: Shashi Tharoor is an Indian politician, bestselling author, and former international diplomat. A former Under-Secretary-General of the United Nations, he served the organisation for nearly three decades before entering public life in India. Since 2009, he has represented Thiruvananthapuram in Parliament and has held key ministerial portfolios, including External Affairs and Human Resource Development. A prolific writer, Tharoor has authored more than 25 books on history, politics, diplomacy, and culture. Renowned for his eloquence and global perspective, he is a sought-after speaker on international affairs, democracy, leadership, and India’s evolving role on the world stage.

speakers.name: Montek Singh Ahluwalia
speakers.title: Former Deputy Chairman, Planning Commission of India · Economist · Public Policy Expert
speakers.bio: Montek Singh Ahluwalia is one of India’s most respected economists and public policy leaders. A key architect of India’s economic reforms, he served as Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission of India from 2004 to 2014 and has held senior positions at the Ministry of Finance, the Prime Minister’s Office, and the World Bank. Over a career spanning more than four decades, he has played a pivotal role in shaping India’s fiscal, economic, and development policies. A distinguished author and thought leader, Ahluwalia continues to contribute to global conversations on economic growth, governance, public policy, and sustainable development.

speakers.name: Raghav Chadha
speakers.title: Member of Parliament (Rajya Sabha) · Chartered Accountant · National Leader, Aam Aadmi Party
speakers.bio: Raghav Chadha is a Member of Parliament in the Rajya Sabha and one of India’s prominent young political leaders. A Chartered Accountant by profession, he entered public life through the Aam Aadmi Party and has held key responsibilities in governance and public policy. He has served as Vice Chairman of the Delhi Jal Board and has been actively involved in legislative discussions on finance, infrastructure, education, and governance reforms. Known for his articulate public speaking and policy-driven approach, Chadha is a regular participant in national and international forums on leadership, public administration, economic development, and the future of democratic governance.

speakers.bio: Suniel Shetty is a respected actor, entrepreneur, and philanthropist who brings authenticity and leadership to every conversation. He speaks passionately about fitness, entrepreneurship, discipline, and building a meaningful life. His real-world experience and grounded wisdom make him a compelling presence at corporate, youth, and motivational events.

speakers.name: Farhan Akhtar
speakers.title: Actor, Filmmaker & Creative Entrepreneur
speakers.bio: Farhan Akhtar’s career spans filmmaking, acting, music, and entrepreneurship. He speaks on creativity, leadership, reinvention, and balancing multiple pursuits. Farhan’s journey reflects discipline, purpose, and adaptability. His conversations appeal to leadership, creative, and youth-driven audiences alike.

speakers.name: Vikrant Massey
speakers.title: Actor & Youth Inspiration
speakers.bio: Vikrant Massey is an acclaimed actor known for his versatile performances and thoughtful approach to storytelling. A grounded speaker, he connects deeply with young audiences, discussing creativity, authenticity, hard work, and navigating the ever-evolving entertainment industry. His inspiring journey makes him ideal for youth and creative-industry events.

speakers.name: Manoj Bajpayee
speakers.title: National Award-Winning Actor
speakers.bio: Manoj Bajpayee is one of India’s most respected actors, known for his transformative roles and dedication to craft. His journey from small-town beginnings to national acclaim offers profound lessons in perseverance, purpose, and excellence. His keynote sessions inspire audiences to pursue passion relentlessly and push creative boundaries fearlessly.

speakers.name: Rhea Chakraborty
speakers.title: Actor, Youth & Wellness Speaker
speakers.bio: Rhea Chakraborty is an actor and youth-inspiration voice who speaks openly about resilience, mental health, and rebuilding life after adversity. Her candid, empathetic storytelling encourages audiences to embrace healing, courage, and self-growth. She connects deeply with young people, making her an impactful speaker for wellness, empowerment, and transformational events.

speakers.name: Tisca Chopra
speakers.title: Actor, Author & Creative Leader
speakers.bio: Tisca Chopra is an acclaimed actor, author, and storyteller known for her thoughtful perspectives on creativity, leadership, and personal reinvention. A dynamic speaker, she engages audiences with insights from film, writing, and life experiences. Her articulate, inspiring presence makes her ideal for corporate, cultural, and women-leadership events.

speakers.name: Neha Dupia
speakers.title: Actor, Producer & Advocate for Women’s Voices
speakers.bio: Neha Dhupia brings candid perspectives shaped by her work across film, media, and entrepreneurship. She speaks on women in leadership, self-belief, and balancing ambition with personal identity. Known for her forthright opinions, Neha encourages open dialogue on confidence, choice, and growth. Her sessions resonate strongly with professional women and leadership forums.

speakers.name: Dia Mirza
speakers.title: Actor, Producer & Sustainability Advocate
speakers.bio: Dia Mirza is widely respected for her work in cinema and environmental advocacy. Her conversations focus on purpose-driven leadership, sustainability, wellbeing, and responsible influence. Dia brings empathy and thoughtfulness to discussions around impact and long-term thinking. She is especially relevant for organisations prioritising ESG, culture, and conscious leadership.

speakers.name: Zoya Akhtar
speakers.title: Filmmaker & Storyteller of Contemporary India
speakers.bio: Zoya Akhtar is an acclaimed filmmaker known for building nuanced, inclusive narratives. She speaks on creativity, leadership, collaboration, and managing diverse teams in high-performance environments. Her insights bridge storytelling with organisational culture and innovation. Zoya’s sessions appeal to leaders navigating complexity and creative decision-making.

speakers.name: Rajkummar Rao
speakers.title: Actor Known for Craft, Discipline & Grit
speakers.bio: Rajkummar Rao’s journey is rooted in perseverance, discipline, and mastery of craft. He speaks about consistency, humility, and long-term growth in competitive environments. His story resonates with audiences navigating early struggles and sustained performance. Rajkummar offers grounded motivation through lived experience rather than abstraction.

speakers.name: Vivek Oberoi
speakers.title: Actor, Entrepreneur & Impact Investor
speakers.bio: Vivek Oberoi bridges the worlds of entertainment, entrepreneurship, and social impact. He speaks on reinvention, conscious business, and aligning purpose with profit. Drawing from his diverse ventures, Vivek shares lessons on adaptability and long-term thinking. His sessions suit leadership, startup, and innovation-driven audiences.

speakers.name: Chitrangada Singh
speakers.title: Actor & Voice of Individuality
speakers.bio: Chitrangada Singh is known for her distinctive choices and quiet confidence. She speaks on resilience, self-expression, and embracing individuality in both personal and professional life. Her conversations encourage authenticity without conformity. Chitrangada resonates strongly with audiences seeking balance between strength and sensitivity.

speakers.name: Karan Johar
speakers.title: Filmmaker, Producer & Cultural Influencer
speakers.bio: Karan Johar is one of India’s most influential creative voices. He speaks on leadership, creativity, brand-building, and navigating public scrutiny. Drawing from decades in media and entrepreneurship, Karan offers insights into relevance, reinvention, and storytelling at scale. His sessions are impactful for leadership and brand-focused audiences.

speakers.name: Karisma Kapoor
speakers.title: Actor & Icon of Reinvention
speakers.bio: Karisma Kapoor’s career reflects longevity, adaptability, and evolution. She speaks on reinvention, sustaining relevance, and embracing change across life stages. Her journey offers lessons in resilience and self-renewal. Karisma connects deeply with audiences navigating transitions and growth.

speakers.name: Rahul Bose
speakers.title: Actor, Athlete & Social Advocate
speakers.bio: Rahul Bose brings a unique blend of cinema, sport, and social consciousness. He speaks on discipline, leadership, equality, and purpose-driven living. Drawing from endurance sports and activism, Rahul’s conversations are direct and thought-provoking. He is well-suited for leadership and impact-led forums.

speakers.name: Rannvijay Singh Singa
speakers.title: Youth Icon & Leadership Communicator
speakers.bio: Rannvijay Singha is known for his strong connect with young professionals and emerging leaders. He speaks on teamwork, resilience, decision-making, and growth through challenge. His style is energetic yet grounded in real experience. Rannvijay is highly effective for youth, campus, and mid-level leadership audiences.

speakers.name: Sonali Bendre
speakers.title: Actor, Author & Resilience Advocate
speakers.bio: Sonali Bendre brings authenticity and emotional depth shaped by personal experience. She speaks on resilience, mental wellbeing, and navigating adversity with grace. Her conversations foster empathy, courage, and strength. Sonali’s sessions are especially impactful for wellbeing and women-centric initiatives.

speakers.name: Imtiaz Ali
speakers.title: Filmmaker & Explorer of Inner Purpose
speakers.bio: Imtiaz Ali is known for stories rooted in self-discovery and emotional truth. He speaks on creativity, purpose, and navigating inner journeys in professional life. His conversations blend philosophy with storytelling. Imtiaz resonates with audiences seeking meaning, reflection, and depth.

speakers.name: Sharan Hegde
speakers.title: Finance Creator & Entrepreneur
speakers.bio: Sharan Hegde, founder of finance platform Finance With Sharan, simplifies money management for millions through humour and relatable content. His talks focus on financial literacy, behaviour change, smart decision-making and creator-led entrepreneurship. He empowers audiences to take control of their financial journeys with clarity, confidence and practical strategies.

speakers.name: Raj Shamani
speakers.title: Entrepreneur, Creator & Speaker
speakers.bio: Raj Shamani is a top business creator, podcaster and entrepreneur inspiring young India with insights on money, entrepreneurship and personal branding. His sessions highlight self-belief, market trends, digital opportunities and building influence with purpose. His energetic, relatable storytelling motivates audiences to learn boldly and pursue disruptive ideas fearlessly.

speakers.name: Neha Nagar
speakers.title: Finance Influencer & Entrepreneur
speakers.bio: Neha Nagar is a popular finance creator simplifying taxes, investing and money concepts for young India. As a speaker, she addresses financial independence, digital entrepreneurship, money mindset and women empowerment. Her relatable, practical approach inspires audiences to become financially aware, responsible and confident in managing their personal finances.

speakers.name: Anushka Rathod
speakers.title: Finance Creator & Educator
speakers.bio: Anushka Rathod, a fast-growing finance creator, is known for making complex financial topics easy, engaging and actionable. Her talks cover saving, investing, smart spending, economic awareness and building credibility online. She empowers young professionals and students to make informed financial choices and develop lifelong money confidence.

speakers.name: Ruhee Dosani
speakers.title: Global Creator & Cultural Storyteller
speakers.bio: Ruhee Dosani, known for her high-energy content and global dance collaborations, is a creator who celebrates diversity and community. As a speaker, she shares insights on authenticity, cross-cultural creativity, digital collaboration and building joyful online spaces. Her vibrant personality inspires audiences to embrace individuality and create fearlessly.

speakers.name: Ranveer Allahbadia
speakers.title: Entrepreneur, Podcaster & Self-Growth Content Creator
speakers.bio: Ranveer Allahbadia is the founder of BeerBiceps and host of The Ranveer Show, one of India’s most popular podcasts. Known for his content on entrepreneurship, mental fitness, spirituality, leadership, and personal growth, he has interviewed global leaders, business icons, athletes, and spiritual masters. Ranveer inspires millions of young Indians to build disciplined habits, long-term thinking, and purpose-driven careers.

speakers.name: Kusha Kapila
speakers.title: Digital Creator, Actor & Culture Commentator
speakers.bio: Kusha Kapila is a leading digital creator and actor known for her sharp observational humor, relatable characters, and commentary on modern Indian life. Rising to prominence through social media, she has since transitioned into films, OTT shows, and major brand collaborations. Her work often explores identity, confidence, relationships, and evolving gender roles with wit and authenticity.

speakers.name: Prajakta Koli
speakers.title: Actor, YouTuber & Youth Icon
speakers.bio: Prajakta Koli, widely known as MostlySane, is one of India’s most influential digital creators and actors. Starting with relatable comedy sketches, she has grown into a global youth voice, acting in films and Netflix series while also serving as a UNDP Youth Climate Champion. Prajakta speaks on self-expression, mental health, resilience, and using digital platforms for positive impact.

speakers.name: Suhani Shah
speakers.title: Mentalist & Illusionist
speakers.bio: Suhani Shah, India’s leading mentalist, blends psychology, intuition and storytelling to create unforgettable experiences. As a speaker-performer, she explores perception, confidence, communication and the science of human behaviour. Her engaging sessions inspire audiences to think differently, challenge assumptions and tap into their hidden potential with curiosity and clarity.

speakers.name: Gurleen Singh
speakers.title: Stand-Up Comedian & Observational Humorist
speakers.bio: Gurleen Singh is a sharp-witted stand-up comedian known for relatable observational humor and quick crowd work. Blending everyday situations with fresh perspectives, Gurleen delivers high-energy performances that connect instantly with audiences. From corporate events to live stages, Gurleen brings laughter, authenticity, and a memorable comedic voice that leaves audiences wanting more.

speakers.name: Naman Anand
speakers.title: Comedian & Digital Creator
speakers.bio: Naman Anand is a rising comedian and content creator known for his sharp wit, relatable humor and modern perspectives on everyday life. As a speaker-performer, he brings authenticity, creativity and fresh insight into youth culture, digital storytelling and creative careers. His engaging style resonates strongly with young, high-energy audiences.

speakers.name: Abhishek Upmanyu
speakers.title: Stand-Up Comedian & Writer
speakers.bio: Abhishek Upmanyu, one of India’s most popular stand-up comedians, is known for his quick delivery, sharp observations and memorable stage presence. As a speaker-performer, he brings humour, authenticity and cultural insight to every audience. His sessions spark laughter while offering witty perspectives on modern life, creativity and communication.

speakers.name: Rahul Subramanian
speakers.title: Stand-Up Comedian & Corporate Satirist
speakers.bio: Rahul Subramanian is a top stand-up comedian celebrated for his clever corporate humour, improvisation and relatable storytelling. As a speaker-performer, he offers unique perspectives on workplaces, communication and navigating modern professional life. His intelligent comedy connects instantly with corporate audiences seeking high-energy entertainment and sharp observational humour.

speakers.name: Rahul Dua
speakers.title: Comedian, Host & Entertainment Personality
speakers.bio: Rahul Dua is a popular comedian and one of India’s most versatile entertainers, known for his charismatic stage presence and effortless humour. As a speaker-performer, he blends wit, storytelling and audience interaction to deliver memorable experiences. His engaging personality makes him a favourite for youth-centric and corporate events.

speakers.name: Kanan Gill
speakers.title: Comedian, Writer & Storyteller
speakers.bio: Kanan Gill is an acclaimed comedian and writer known for his intelligent humour, thoughtful observations and creative storytelling. As a speaker-performer, he explores creativity, self-expression, navigating modern pressures and finding one’s voice. His calm yet comedic style resonates widely, making him ideal for corporate, college and creative-industry audiences.

speakers.name: Vir Das
speakers.title: Emmy-winning Comedian & Actor
speakers.bio: Vir Das is a globally acclaimed comedian, actor and International Emmy winner known for his sharp writing, global perspective and boundary-pushing performances. As a speaker-performer, he discusses creativity, identity, comedy as social commentary and building international careers. His unique voice inspires audiences to think boldly and embrace originality.

speakers.name: Zakir Khan
speakers.title: Comedian, Storyteller & Cultural Voice
speakers.bio: Zakir Khan, one of India’s most beloved comedians, is celebrated for his heartfelt storytelling, poetic humour and deep relatability. As a speaker-performer, he shares insights on authenticity, resilience, creative journeys and connecting emotionally through humour. His warm presence inspires audiences to embrace vulnerability, simplicity and meaningful expression.

speakers.name: Anubhav Singh Bassi
speakers.title: Comedian & Youth Icon
speakers.bio: Bassi is a breakout comedy star known for his hilarious, nostalgia-driven storytelling and effortless stage charisma. As a speaker-performer, he brings humour, relatability and insights on self-discovery, career twists and embracing life’s unpredictability. His engaging style makes him a top choice for youth festivals and corporate events.

speakers.name: Atul Khatri
speakers.title: Corporate Comedy Specialist & Observational Humorist
speakers.bio: Atul Khatri is one of India’s most trusted comedians for corporate audiences. With sharp observational humor rooted in office life, family, and everyday experiences, he delivers clean, intelligent comedy that resonates across age groups. His polished, professional style makes him a favourite for leadership events and large corporate gatherings.

speakers.name: Amit Tandon
speakers.title: Clean Comedy Expert & Relatable Storyteller
speakers.bio: Amit Tandon is widely known as “the married guy” of Indian comedy, bringing clean, relatable humor drawn from family life and workplace realities. His comedy connects effortlessly with diverse audiences, making him an excellent choice for corporates seeking inclusive, feel-good entertainment without edgy content.

speakers.name: Akash Gupta
speakers.title: High-Energy Storyteller & Youth Icon
speakers.bio: Akash Gupta is a popular stand-up comedian known for his energetic performances and animated storytelling. His humor rooted in personal experiences, ambition, and modern work-life culture appeals strongly to young professionals and millennial audiences, making him ideal for dynamic corporate celebrations and employee engagement events.

speakers.name: Gaurav Gupta
speakers.title: Character Comedy Specialist & Observational Performer
speakers.bio: Gaurav Gupta is best known for his hilarious character-based comedy, especially his iconic portrayals inspired by Indian family dynamics. His clean, situational humor works exceptionally well for corporates, creating high recall and laughter without crossing comfort boundaries.

speakers.name: Prashasti Singh
speakers.title: Sharp Observational Comic & Contemporary Voice
speakers.bio: Prashasti Singh is a bold, intelligent comedian known for her sharp takes on modern life, workplace culture, and social dynamics. Her confident stage presence and witty storytelling make her a strong fit for progressive corporate audiences seeking fresh, contemporary humor.

speakers.name: Biswa Kalyan Rath
speakers.title: Intellectual Humorist & Story-Driven Performer
speakers.bio: Biswa Kalyan Rath is known for his clever, introspective comedy that blends logic, life experiences, and observational humor. His structured storytelling and sharp punchlines appeal particularly to thinking audiences, making him a great choice for corporates looking for smart, engaging entertainment.

speakers.name: Johnson Ebenezer
speakers.title: Culinary Innovator & Hospitality Leader
speakers.bio: Chef Johnson is a celebrated culinary expert known for his creative approach to regional Indian flavours and modern presentation. As a speaker, he shares insights on food innovation, kitchen leadership, sustainability and the evolving dining culture. His warm storytelling inspires audiences to appreciate craftsmanship, discipline and passion in the culinary arts.

speakers.name: Chef Manuel Olveria
speakers.title: Global Cuisine Specialist
speakers.bio: Chef Manuel is an accomplished chef recognised for his mastery of international cuisines and refined culinary techniques. His sessions explore creativity, flavour balance, menu design and global food trends. As a speaker, he brings rich cross-cultural perspectives, motivating audiences to experiment boldly and elevate their culinary understanding.

speakers.name: Chef Ranveer Brar
speakers.title: Celebrity Chef, Author & Culinary Explorer
speakers.bio: Chef Ranveer Brar, one of India’s most loved chefs, is known for his television shows, restaurants and passionate storytelling about food heritage. As a speaker, he discusses creativity, culture, entrepreneurship and India’s culinary identity. His engaging presence inspires audiences to celebrate flavours, explore roots and build meaningful connections through food.

speakers.name: Chef Guntas Sethi
speakers.title: Pastry Artist & Food Educator
speakers.bio: Chef Guntas Sethi is a renowned pastry chef celebrated for her elegant desserts and modern baking techniques. She speaks on creativity, innovation in patisserie, ingredient science and building culinary confidence. Her approachable style and artistic expertise inspire young chefs, home bakers and professionals to embrace precision and imagination.

speakers.name: Chef Garima Arora
speakers.title: Michelin-Starred Chef & Culinary Visionary
speakers.bio: Chef Garima Arora, India’s first Michelin-starred female chef, is globally recognised for her progressive Indian cuisine and bold, thoughtful flavours. As a speaker, she highlights culinary innovation, leadership, sustainability and reimagining tradition. Her journey empowers audiences to break barriers, pursue excellence and celebrate India’s gastronomic diversity.

speakers.name: Chef Himanshu Saini
speakers.title: Modern Indian Cuisine Pioneer
speakers.bio: Chef Himanshu Saini, the creative force behind Trèsind and winner of global acclaim, is known for redefining modern Indian gastronomy. His talks focus on innovation, technique, storytelling through food and elevating traditional flavours with modern artistry. His visionary approach inspires chefs and food lovers to push culinary boundaries courageously.

speakers.name: Sanjeev Kapoor
speakers.title: Culinary Icon & Global Ambassador of Indian Cuisine
speakers.bio: Sanjeev Kapoor is one of India’s most celebrated chefs, best known for hosting Khana Khazana, one of the longest-running cooking shows globally. A Padma Shri awardee, restaurateur, author, and entrepreneur, he has significantly influenced modern Indian cooking and brought Indian cuisine to international audiences.

speakers.name: Kunal Kapoor
speakers.title: Celebrity Chef & Culinary Innovator
speakers.bio: Kunal Kapur is a renowned Indian chef, restaurateur, and television personality, widely recognised as a judge on MasterChef India. Known for blending traditional flavors with contemporary techniques, he is an author and entrepreneur passionate about reviving regional Indian cuisines and mentoring aspiring chefs nationwide.

speakers.name: Sanjyot Keer
speakers.title: Digital Culinary Creator & Modern Indian Food Expert
speakers.bio: Sanjyot Keer is a popular chef and digital food content creator known for his innovative, easy-to-follow recipes. As the face behind Your Food Lab, he has transformed home cooking through engaging video content, making gourmet techniques accessible to millions across social media platforms.

speakers.name: Harpal Singh Sokhi
speakers.title: Celebrity Chef & Champion of Indian Flavours
speakers.bio: Harpal Singh Sokhi is a vibrant chef and television personality known for his energetic style and deep love for Indian cuisine. Famous for his signature phrase “Namak Shamak,” he promotes regional Indian flavors through restaurants, cookbooks, and culinary shows worldwide.

speakers.name: Vikas Khanna
speakers.title: Michelin-Star Chef & Global Humanitarian
speakers.bio: Vikas Khanna is an internationally acclaimed Michelin-starred chef, author, filmmaker, and humanitarian. Based in New York, he has elevated Indian cuisine globally while actively contributing to social causes. A MasterChef India judge, he is known for blending culinary artistry with culture, compassion, and storytelling.
topics: Indian cuisine on the world stage

speakers.name: Srikanth Bolla
speakers.title: Founder & Chairman, Bollant Industries
speakers.bio: Srikanth Bolla, founder and chairman of Bollant Industries, is a visually impaired entrepreneur who became the first international blind student in Management Science at MIT’s Sloan School of Management. Backed by Ratan Tata, his company makes eco-friendly products and employs people with disabilities. His story inspired the film Srikanth, and he speaks on resilience, inclusion and building a business against the odds.

speakers.name: Revant Himatsingka
speakers.title: Health Educator & Creator, FoodPharmer
speakers.bio: Revant Himatsingka, known to millions as FoodPharmer, is a Wharton MBA and certified health coach who left a corporate consulting career to help Indians eat better. Through his Label Padhega India campaign, he teaches people to read food labels and spot hidden sugar, salt and unhealthy fats. He speaks on nutrition literacy, healthy habits and making informed choices as consumers.
